comparison.objective: Install or position paper-tray side guides, versus finish installed HELICOIL inserts by tang fracture and recovery.
comparison.physical_skill: Guide placement/adjustment versus bimanual coaxial mandrel holding, regulated hammering, fracture control, and fragment retrieval.
comparison.success_condition: Side guides installed or positioned versus four fractured and contained tangs without coil or shell damage. The record supplies no detailed rubric or thresholds.
comparison.reason: Even if guide installation involves alignment or insertion, it does not test impact-induced notch fracture and loose-fragment containment.
